Jain tradition holds that 24 Jinas (Tirthankaras) have appeared in our age.

ANSWER: C
first_answers.nemo:
In Jain tradition, there are 24 Tirthankaras (Jinas) in each half-cycle of time. Our current descending half-cycle (Avasarpini) has had 24 Jinas appear, from Rishabhanatha to Mahavira.

ANSWER: C
